title: krabarena-bench task YAML
description: One scenario every tool must run. Conforms to AUTHORING_BATTLES §6.

id.description: Slug-form task identifier; matches the YAML filename stem.

fixture_service.description: Name of the Compose service in fixtures/compose.yml that this task targets.

inputs.description: Free-form, task-specific inputs passed to the runner.

expected.description: Free-form, task-specific expected outputs used by success_predicate.

success_predicate.description: Python expression evaluated against the runner's structured output. Must be deterministic and side-effect-free.

timeout_s.description: Hard wall-clock cap for a single iteration.

iterations.description: Number of independent iterations. Same value for every tool — the framework forbids per-tool overrides.
